name: EXAR Ultra DB508
positioning: Carbon-spoke 50/58 mm road wheelset with a 23 mm inner width and tire-size pressure caps.

rim.bead_note: Hooked or hookless is not stated; the maker lists clincher and tubeless tires.

max_pressure.note: Clincher 25c. Lower caps for wider tires: clincher 110/100/90 psi and tubeless 100/90/80 psi at 28/30/32c; tubeless 25c 110 psi.

load_limit.note: Not published on the product page.

weight.basis: Pair without skewers and rim tape.

hub: Magene hub · 36T ratchet, DT-compatible and replaceable · ceramic bearings

price_observations.conditions: Shimano freehub; US$1,239 with SRAM XDR or Campagnolo N3W. Tax included; delivery in 5–10 working days.

caveats: Bead type, rotor mount, load limit and warranty term are not published on the product page.
Keep to the lower pressure caps for 28–32c tires.
An independent review flags the radial rear brake-side lacing as a possible spoke-stress point under braking.
Mainland China price not recorded; confirm it with an authorized seller.

independent_evidence.summary: the5krunner scored the DB508 83% in an unsponsored review: good, well-made wheels; it records no measured weight.
